content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RGNAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RGNAU Security Guard recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview, and candidates need to attend on the specified date, which is 12 September 2026. There is no separate last date for application submission.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Security Guard posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation or the 10th standard. For the Armed Security Guard post, a valid Arms License is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Security Guard positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Security Guard posts is 40 years. Age relaxation is provided for Ex-Servicemen and personnel from Central Paramilitary and Police forces.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Security Guards at RGNAU?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies for Security Guard posts. These are divided into Armed Security Guard (Male) and Unarmed Security Guard (Female/Male) categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Security Guard posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Security Guards ranges from Rs. 760 to Rs. 893 per day, depending on the specific post (Armed or Unarmed).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for RGNAU Security Guard recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the RGNAU Security Guard jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, a Physical Fitness Test, and a Security Interaction Evaluation.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview for RGNAU Security Guard recruitment be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University, Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, 229302.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Security Guard posts at RGNAU are on a contractual basis.
